projectDescription: A local-first daily task manager built with React, TypeScript, Dexie (IndexedDB), and TanStack Query for centralized caching and automatic UI synchronization.
keyFeatures: Local-first persistence with IndexedDB via Dexie — no backend required
TanStack Query as the data orchestration layer with centralized caching
Automatic UI synchronization through query invalidation on mutations
Add tasks with title and optional description
Toggle task completion with instant UI feedback
Delete tasks with optimistic cache invalidation
Filter tasks by all / completed / pending
Dashboard counters showing total, completed, and pending task counts
Layered architecture enabling easy migration from local DB to remote API
Built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Radix UI primitives
publicApiSurface: useTasks() — query hook returning all tasks
useTask(id: number) — query hook returning a single task by ID
useAddTask() — mutation hook to add a new task
useUpdateTask() — mutation hook to update task fields (e.g. toggle completion)
useDeleteTask() — mutation hook to delete a task by ID
taskService.getAllTasks() — returns all Task records from IndexedDB
taskService.getTaskById(id) — returns a single Task by ID
taskService.addTask(task) — inserts a new Task and returns its generated ID
taskService.updateTask(id, updates) — partially updates a Task
taskService.deleteTask(id) — removes a Task from IndexedDB
Task interface — { id?, title, description?, completed, createdAt, category? }
